title: Employer Benefit Charging Timeliness Bulletin: The Answer Window Share
content:
**Employer Benefit Charging — answer window share for a separation response.**

The answer window share is the whole when the response is received no later than the response window after the notice of claim mailing date; nine tenths when it is received after the response due date and no benefit charge has been posted on the position after that due date; and three quarters otherwise, a response received after the due date when a payment has been charged while the answer was overdue.

| When the response is received | Benefit charge posted on the position after the due date | Answer window share |
|---|---|---|
| On or before the response due date | — | 1.00 (the whole) |
| After the response due date | None | 0.90 (nine tenths) |
| After the response due date | One or more | 0.75 (three quarters) |

**Dates used.**
- *The response due date* is the last day of the response window, as recorded on the position.
- *When the response is received* is the day the response is lodged.
- *A charge posted after the due date* is a benefit charge whose posting date is later than the due date; a charge posted on the due date itself is not after it.
- The share turns only on these dates.

**Date cases (hypothetical; response due date 13 March).**

| Response received | Latest benefit charge posted | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 13 March | 11 March | 1.00 |
| 20 March | 13 March | 0.90 |
| 20 March | 18 March | 0.75 |
| 20 March | No charge posted | 0.90 |
